Delhi Air Quality Dips to 'Very Poor' Post-Diwali

Delhi's air quality deteriorated to the 'very poor' category following Diwali festivities, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) reaching 303. This decline was exacerbated by stubble burning in neighboring states. Some reports indicated AQI levels as high as 400 in certain areas, with 20 monitoring stations recording severe air quality. In response to the pollution, schools in Noida and Greater Noida transitioned to a hybrid learning model for classes up to the 5th grade. One report noted that Supreme Court orders regarding pollution control appeared to have been flouted.
